thread:
arthur: FYI NimbusCloud notified we were short-shipped 1 rack from shipment S-3321. Manifest shows 5, truck had 4. This affects Dedicated EU tranche (resv R-2026-078). Need allocation plan.
kevin: On it. Nimbus says short-ship due to SKU re-packaging at their supplier. ETA for the missing rack is 2026-05-05 but could be earlier if they prioritize. Does anyone own impacted customers list?
sasha: Major impacted: StreamlineAI (EU-only), PaxPay (SLA), and two internal staging pools. StreamlineAI needs local racks for compliance. PaxPay has a 99.9% latency SLO next quarter.
natalie: Can we split traffic across existing EU racks + cloud-marketplace burst for non-sensitive flows? Marketplace partner (CloudArc) gave 48-hr burst quota but egress is higher than a dedicated rack.
vendor_bot: NimbusCloud update: "Short-ship confirmed. Priority rebuild initiated. Expedited shipping option available: +$22k per rack, ship 2026-04-29. Standard re-ship ETA 2026-05-05." Quote ID: NIM-Q-2247.
ryan: Finance: +$22k vs marketplace ~$9k/week for our profile. If we take exp freight, need PO and vendor approval before EOD. Also check customs clearance slot.
claire: Ops: We have 2 spare nodes in EU-1 pool we can borrow for PaxPay for 72h. That buys time. But StreamlineAI cannot be moved. We should prioritize sending them the missing rack if possible.
julia: Suggestion: (A) Allocate spare nodes to PaxPay now (low risk), (B) Book expedited for 1 rack for StreamlineAI, (C) Use marketplace burst for non-sensitive staging. Need go-ahead from finance for the expedite.
arthur: I like that. @ryan can you fast-track PO for one expedite? Also inform Nimbus to hold one rack for StreamlineAI with white-glove handling.
natalie: I'll check CloudArc burst window and cost; we might combine a 48-72h burst with the spare nodes.
ryan: I'll approve PO if legal ok. @sasha can you confirm contract terms for StreamlineAI allow expedited delivery and any billing pass-through?
sasha: Contract gives us procurement flexibility but any cost pass-through needs customer sign-off. I'll draft a short billing addendum and ping StreamlineAM (sic) ops now.
natalie: CloudArc confirms burst capacity available for 3 days starting 2026-04-28. Cost estimate ~$8.4k for our expected load.
natalie: minor correction: CloudArc says 48-hr window starting 04-28 06:00Z.
claire: Ops runbook: executing borrow now for PaxPay. Running command: `resv loan R-2026-078 --to eu-1 --count 2 --ttl 72h`. Will post results.
arthur: Great. @vendor_bot confirm we should lock expedited quote NIM-Q-2247 and instruct customs broker to prioritize.
vendor_bot: NimbusCloud: Expedited rack allocated pending PO. Shipping hold for white-glove handling requested. AWB and customs docs will be provided after PO.
ryan: PO issued for NIM-Q-2247, ID PO-8812. Sent to procurement and Nimbus.
sasha: I've messaged StreamlineAI legal ops for emergency billing approval. Will update in thread.
julia: I'll prepare customer comms templates for PaxPay and StreamlineAI in case they ask. Keep messages minimal and technical.
arthur: Thanks. If expedited falls through we fallback to marketplace + borrow plan. I'll close the loop when AWB arrives.
kevin: Noted. Please add ETA updates here. If Nimbus slips again we escalate to vendor partnerships manager.
sasha: StreamlineAI replied: 'approved for expedited delivery and cost pass-through. Please proceed.' :thumbsup:
arthur: Perfect. Marking actions: Claire borrowing nodes (done), Ryan PO (done), Natalie marketplace hold (48h), Vendor to ship expedited once docs arrive. Closing until AWB.
